title.en: Learning TFT: what was actually known when a forecast was issued?
title.zh: TFT 学习：预测发出时，哪些信息真的已知？

summary.en: Separate static, observed and known-future inputs; work through quantile loss and keep attention explanations separate from causal claims.
summary.zh: 分清静态、历史观测与已知未来输入，手算分位数损失，并区分注意力解释与因果结论。

basis.en: A study note prepared alongside the author-provided climate-risk abstract, using the sources below and a new standard-library Python example. The example uses invented values and is not the manuscript implementation or a research reproduction.
basis.zh: 结合作者提供的气候风险摘要、下方来源与新编写的标准库 Python 示例整理。示例使用虚构数值，不是论文实现，也不属于论文复现实验。

paragraphs.en: At an origin t, predict a named outcome at t+h. The unit might be a province and the target a documented risk indicator. That statement needs an issue date, horizon, target definition and available input history. An annual risk assessment with contemporaneous variables is not automatically a prospective forecast.
paragraphs.zh: 以时点 t 为起点，预测 t+h 的某个明确指标。样本单位可以是省份，目标可以是定义清楚的风险指标，但必须同时写明发布时间、预测跨度、目标定义与可用历史。使用同期变量的年度风险评估，不自动等同于面向未来的预测。

paragraphs.en: The supplied abstract mentions TFT–GNN, but does not give its forecasting horizon or target construction. The examples here explain questions to ask when reading or implementing TFT; they do not fill in those missing manuscript details.
paragraphs.zh: 当前摘要提到 TFT–GNN，但没有给出预测跨度与目标构造细节。本篇说明学习或实现 TFT 时应问的问题，不替论文补写这些设定。

paragraphs.en: Static context describes an entity; observed inputs become known through measurement; known-future inputs are available for a future target time before the forecast is issued. Each field needs both the period it describes and the date its value became available.
paragraphs.zh: 静态上下文描述对象；观测输入通过测量获得；已知未来输入则在预测发出前，已经能确定未来目标时点的取值。每个字段都需要同时记录“描述哪个时期”和“何时能获得”。

bullets.en: A future calendar year or scheduled event can be known. Realized rainfall next year cannot be treated as known-future rainfall. A weather forecast is a different, vintage-specific input.
bullets.zh: 未来日历或已公布的计划可以已知；下一年的实测降水不能当作已知未来降水。天气预报是另一种带有发布版本的输入。

bullets.en: A statistic for 2015 revised in 2018 is unavailable to a forecast issued in 2016. Historical validity is not the same as historical availability.
bullets.zh: 2015 年统计值若在 2018 年才修订发布，就不能直接给 2016 年发出的预测使用。“历史年份”不等于“当时可获得”。

bullets.en: Static does not mean timeless: a topology or installed-capacity category may change. Version it at the forecast origin when necessary.
bullets.zh: 静态不等于永久不变：网络结构或装机类别可能变化，必要时也要保存预测时点对应的版本。

title.en: 03 / Read the TFT components by their job
title.zh: 03 / 按职责理解 TFT 组件

paragraphs.en: The original TFT combines variable selection, static-covariate context, recurrent processing for local temporal structure, attention for longer dependencies and gating/residual mechanisms. Its multi-horizon quantile outputs answer a different question from a single deterministic score.
paragraphs.zh: 原始 TFT 将变量选择、静态协变量上下文、处理局部时间结构的循环模块、处理较长依赖的注意力，以及门控和残差机制结合起来。多步分位数输出回答的问题，与单个确定性分数不同。

paragraphs.en: Start with a seasonal or persistence baseline and a simpler model using the same information. Compare errors by horizon, region and extreme-event subset. A large architecture alone is not evidence that a small panel needs it.
paragraphs.zh: 先建立季节性或持续性基线，再比较使用相同信息的简单模型。分预测跨度、地区和极端事件子集查看误差；模型规模本身不能证明小型面板需要复杂结构。

title.zh: 04 / 手算不对称的分位数损失

paragraphs.en: For residual e = y − q̂, pinball loss is max(τe, (τ−1)e). At τ=0.9, underpredicting by 2 costs 1.8; overpredicting by 2 costs 0.2. For y=[10,20] and predictions [12,18], the mean loss is 1.0.
paragraphs.zh: 令残差 e = y − q̂，pinball loss 为 max(τe, (τ−1)e)。当 τ=0.9 时，少预测 2 的损失为 1.8，多预测 2 的损失为 0.2。真实值 [10,20]、预测值 [12,18] 的平均损失为 1.0。

paragraphs.en: A nominal 10th–90th percentile interval targets 80% coverage; it does not guarantee it. Measure empirical coverage and interval width on held-out cases, check quantile crossing, and inspect regional coverage rather than treating a narrow interval as proof of reliability.
paragraphs.zh: 10%—90% 分位区间的名义覆盖率为 80%，但不保证实际覆盖率达到 80%。应在独立样本上测覆盖率与区间宽度、检查分位数交叉，并查看地区差异；区间窄不等于可靠。

code.text:
from climate_protocol import pinball_loss

loss = pinball_loss([10, 20], [12, 18], 0.9)
assert abs(loss - 1.0) < 1e-12

title.zh: 05 / 运行一个信息可用性检查

paragraphs.en: From the repository root, run the commands below with Python 3.8 or later. No GPU, PyTorch or model weights are needed. The import snippet above can be run from notebook/examples. Expected availability outputs are true, false, false for the future calendar, future observed rainfall and late historical revision.
paragraphs.zh: 在仓库根目录使用 Python 3.8 及以上运行下列命令，无需 GPU、PyTorch 或模型权重。上方导入片段可在 notebook/examples 目录执行。未来日历、未来实测降水和晚发布历史修订值的预期可用性依次为 true、false、false。

code.text:
python notebook/examples/climate_protocol.py
python -m unittest discover -s notebook/examples -p test_climate_protocol.py -v

title.zh: 06 / 一个值得保留的阅读习惯

paragraphs.en: Before comparing attention plots, write an availability ledger. Ask which input would disappear if the forecast were replayed at its original issue time. Variable-selection and attention weights can describe model behavior, but they are not causal effects or automatically stable explanations.
paragraphs.zh: 比较注意力图之前，先列一张信息可用性台账：如果回到预测当时，哪些输入会消失？变量选择权重与注意力权重可以描述模型行为，却不是因果效应，也不自动代表稳定解释。

callout.en: These checks validate loss arithmetic and information rules only. No TFT training or manuscript performance is evaluated here.
callout.zh: 这些检查仅验证损失计算与信息规则；本示例未训练 TFT，也未评估论文性能。
